notes.title: Amazing Grace -What color is your attribute?-
notes.content:
We hope you are having a wonderful experience in Dōkyūsei: Bangin' Summer. Today, we'd like to introduce our upcoming visual novel, Amazing Grace -What color is your attribute?-.

It's not a remake of a classic visual novel, but you'll develop relationships with adorable characters in various locations (including schools), just like Dōkyūsei! 

Click here to visit the store page and find out more!
Remember to wishlist the game to receive notifications on the release day.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2553910/Amazing_Grace_What_color_is_your_attribute/

We aim to bring even more Japanese VNs to the West.
The announcements will be made on our X (Twitter), so make sure to follow!
https://twitter.com/shiravune

Thank you for your support of Dōkyūsei: Bangin' Summer and Shiravune.
